fact: In September 2024 ElectriFI announced an LSL 40 million investment in preferred redeemable shares in OnePower Lesotho's Sotho Minigrid Portfolio, and the review found no other verifiable equity transaction into a Lesotho startup between November 2023 and November 2026.
title: Lesotho Startup Funding: Hundreds Incubated, Little Equity
